thread:
Anya: Quick huddle — need to lock scope + launch criteria for the new 'Observe' pane before EOD Friday. Main asks: dashboards (cost & errors), trace hooks (sampling APIs), per-route cost breakdown, and a lightweight rollout plan. Any blockers?

Dave: Two quick infra notes: tracing hooks require hook points in the runtime (pre/post request) — that'll add ~3-5% tail latency if we do span capture + KVs. We can mitigate with sampling and async export.

Sara: Customers keep asking for per-route cost + top-N error buckets. Can we ship a cheap MVP: aggregated per-route cost + error rate, no traces, then add trace drilldowns later? :thinking_face:

Mike: UX tradeoff — dashboards vs single pane. If we show cost + errors in one view, we need clear affordances for time range + sampling. Mockup incoming.

Anya: Proposal: MVP scope = (1) per-route cost rollup (24h/7d/30d), (2) top 10 error signatures, (3) retention: 7d aggregated metrics, (4) trace hooks behind feature flag with 1% default sampling. Launch criteria: perf checks <= 5% median latency impact on gen requests, per-route cost shows within 10% accuracy vs billing, and product sign-off. Agree?

Dave: OK but 1% sampling still needs runtime support for span IDs + KV cache tagging. I'll need 2 sprint chunks: infra + export. For the perf check, suggest a canary on Dedicated first.

Sara: Customer fallback: if trace export fails, show note + degrade to aggregated errors only. Also request: include 'cost per 1k tokens' quick calc in UI.

Mike: Mockup link: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/observe-pane — shows layout + drilldown. Suggest we surface sampling toggle in the header. :thumbsup:

Anya: Perf experiments plan: run A/B with sampling on/off for 48h, collect p95 latency, and token cost delta. Dave — can you add a test harness? @Dave

Dave: On it. I'll add a small test script: ```python
# stress harness
for i in range(1000):
  call_api(prompt='x'*1000)
``` 
I'll also add metrics: trace_export_success, trace_queue_latency.

infra-bot: deploy/ci — perf-harness job queued (job id 6821).

Sara: Decision: Trim full-trace storage from MVP. Keep traces ephemeral for 7 days behind flag. Add a roadmap item for: correlated token-level cost + spans.

Anya: OK final: I'll update the PRD with scope cuts and acceptance criteria, tag eng + design, and schedule a quick review tomorrow 11am. Thanks everyone.

Mike: 11am works.

Dave: :+1:

Sara: :white_check_mark:
